links.comparator_used: Models fine-tuned only to public clinical datasets (I2B2/N2C2, emrQA) and externally validated on the local Pakistani EHR data, without local fine-tuning
links.outcome: Medical concept extraction performance (3-label precision, recall, F1, accuracy) on the local EHR dataset
links.effect: 3-label precision, recall, F1 score, and accuracy improved by 21-31%, 11-21%, 16-27%, and 6-10% amongst GatorTron, BioMegatron, BioBert and ClinicalBERT; 9-label trends similar. ChatGPT was an exception, performing better on the local EHR dataset by 10% for precision and 13% for recall, F1 and accuracy.
links.quote: Fine-tuning the LLMs to the local EHR data improved model performance.

design_hint: local validation and fine-tuning before deployment
